title: ASC 450 Loss Contingencies and Going Concern - DemoCo at 2026-06-30
conclusionSummary: Of three loss contingencies at 2026-06-30, the supplier litigation is probable and estimable in a range of 400,000 to 900,000 USD with no better estimate within it, so 400,000 USD is accrued; the regulatory inquiry is reasonably possible (disclosed, not accrued); the guarantee of an affiliate's facility is remote (disclosed). Management's evaluation finds no substantial doubt about DemoCo's ability to continue as a going concern within one year of issuance.
